social.title: A Long Night at Café 't Smalle
social.description: Drink in a 1786 brown café with a tiny canal-side deck, where the wood is dark and the beer comes with two fingers of head.
social.bonus: Get the outside table on the water, however long it takes.

social.title: Sunday Session at Hannekes Boom
social.description: A scrapwood shack on the water in the east where the whole city seems to end up on a warm afternoon.
social.bonus: Arrive by boat if you can.

social.title: A Full Night at Melkweg
social.description: Catch a band in an old sugar mill, then stay for the club night that starts the moment the gear is off the stage.
social.bonus: Stay for the room you did not buy a ticket for.

social.title: Night at Shelter, Under the A'DAM Tower
social.description: Go underground beneath the tower for a low-ceilinged techno room that runs until well after breakfast.
social.bonus: Take the first ferry back at sunrise.

social.title: Arcade and Beers at TonTon Club
social.description: Play thirty-year-old cabinets and pinball with a beer in your hand, in a bar that charges you by the game.
social.bonus: Beat someone you have never met at something.

social.title: An Afternoon That Becomes a Night at Westergasfabriek
social.description: A former gasworks turned into a park full of bars, breweries, cinemas and whatever festival happens to be on that weekend.
social.bonus: Go with no plan and see what is on when you arrive.

social.title: Karaoke Booth at Duke of Tokyo
social.description: Take a private Japanese-style room, order the fried chicken, and sing badly for two hours with the door closed.
social.bonus: Sing something in a language you do not speak.

social.title: English-Language Comedy at Boom Chicago
social.description: Improv and sketch in a Leidseplein theatre that has been launching comedians for thirty years, with drinks at the table.
social.bonus: Shout out a suggestion during the improv set.

social.title: Live Show at Paradiso
social.description: Catch a gig inside a converted 19th-century church turned legendary concert venue, the room alone is worth the ticket.
social.bonus: Check out the balcony view before you head to the floor.

social.title: Group Canal Cruise at Night
social.description: Book a small boat with friends and cruise the illuminated canal ring after dark, bring your own drinks and playlist.
social.bonus: Wave at every other boat you pass.

chill.title: A Spa Day at Zuiver
chill.description: A whole day of pools, saunas and a lake at the edge of the Amsterdamse Bos, phone locked in a locker.
chill.bonus: Sit through one full aufguss session.

chill.title: A Slow Morning in Sarphatipark
chill.description: Take coffee and a pastry from De Pijp into the small park locals actually use, and do nothing at all for two hours.
chill.bonus: No phone for the entire two hours.

chill.title: The Silence of the Begijnhof
chill.description: Push through an unmarked door off a busy street into a 14th-century courtyard where people still live and nobody raises their voice.

chill.title: The Waterside Terrace at Café de Jaren
chill.description: Take the big sunny deck out over the Amstel with a coffee and the stack of newspapers they still put out.
chill.bonus: Stay long enough to finish something you're reading.

chill.title: Sunset on the NEMO Rooftop
chill.description: Climb the free stepped roof of the green ship-shaped science museum for the best open view of the old harbour.
chill.bonus: Bring something to drink and stay for the whole sunset.

chill.title: Art Deco Sauna at Sauna Deco
chill.description: Sweat in a 1920s interior salvaged from a Parisian department store, with stained glass and wrought iron everywhere you look.
chill.bonus: Do the cold plunge every round.

chill.title: Picnic in Vondelpark
chill.description: Grab bread, cheese, and wine from a nearby shop and stake out a patch of grass in the city's favorite park.
chill.bonus: Bring a frisbee and rope in a stranger's game.

chill.title: Canal-Side Coffee at Café Papeneiland
chill.description: Take a window seat at this 17th-century canal-corner cafe and watch the boats and bikes go by over a slice of apple pie.
chill.bonus: Order the apple pie, it's the thing to get here.

chill.title: Free Wander Through the Rijksmuseum Gardens
chill.description: Skip the ticket line and walk the museum's sculpture-lined gardens instead, free, quiet, and gorgeous in any season.
chill.bonus: Find the hidden reading room inside the garden pavilion.

chill.title: An Afternoon at Hortus Botanicus
chill.description: Wander one of the world's oldest botanical gardens, tucked away in the city center with a butterfly greenhouse and tropical palm house.

adventure.title: A Private Saloon Boat at Golden Hour
adventure.description: Hire a wood-panelled boat with a skipper, load it with drinks, and take the canals slowly while the gable lights come on.
adventure.bonus: Bring your own bottle and a proper playlist.

adventure.title: Ride the Bulb Fields to Keukenhof
adventure.description: Cycle the flat lanes between blocks of tulips so saturated they look printed, ending in the largest flower garden in the world.
adventure.bonus: Ride the field loop before you go into the garden.

adventure.title: Row the Bosbaan in the Amsterdamse Bos
adventure.description: Cycle twenty minutes south into a forest three times the size of Central Park and take a boat out on its two-kilometre rowing lake.
adventure.bonus: Find the goat farm and stay for the fresh cheese.

adventure.title: Train to the Beach at Zandvoort
adventure.description: Half an hour to the North Sea, where the beach clubs run right down onto the sand and the wind is always doing something.
adventure.bonus: Get in the water, however cold it is.

adventure.title: Rent a Sloep and Drive It Yourself
adventure.description: No licence, no crew, just a little open boat, a tiller and the Jordaan canals for the afternoon.
adventure.bonus: Get through a bridge without touching the sides.

adventure.title: Cycle Into Waterland
adventure.description: Ride twenty minutes out of the centre and you are on a dyke path through polders, wooden villages and more cows than people.
adventure.bonus: Stop for coffee in Ransdorp and look up at the unfinished church tower.

adventure.title: Cycle the Dunes at Zuid-Kennemerland
adventure.description: Ride through a national park of sand hills and pine where wild bison actually graze, ending at the sea.
adventure.bonus: Spot the bison herd from the viewing hide.

adventure.title: Sail a Classic Boat on the IJsselmeer
adventure.description: Take a flat-bottomed wooden boat out of Monnickendam onto the inland sea, where the crew will let you haul the sails yourself.
adventure.bonus: Take a turn on the tiller.

adventure.title: Swing Off the Edge of the A'DAM Tower
adventure.description: Sit on Europe's highest swing, a hundred metres up, and get pushed out over the edge of the building with the whole IJ behind you.
adventure.bonus: Keep your eyes open the whole swing.

adventure.title: Climb the Westerkerk Tower
adventure.description: Take the narrow stair up the tallest church tower in the city for a view straight down over the Jordaan rooftops.
adventure.bonus: Time it so you are up there when the carillon plays.

adventure.title: Kayak the Amsterdam Canals
adventure.description: Rent a kayak and paddle beneath the Golden Age canal houses from water level, a totally different city than the one on foot.
adventure.bonus: Paddle under at least 5 bridges before you turn back.

adventure.title: Bike to the Windmills of Zaanse Schans
adventure.description: Pedal out to a working windmill village on the Zaan river and watch cheese and clogs being made by hand.
adventure.bonus: Buy a wedge of cheese straight from the windmill.

adventure.title: Rent Bikes and Ride the Vondelpark Loop
adventure.description: Grab a pair of city bikes and do a proper loop of Vondelpark like an actual Amsterdammer.
adventure.bonus: Ring your bell at a fellow cyclist, friendly-style.

adventure.title: Stand-Up Paddleboard the Canals
adventure.description: Balance your way through the canal ring on a SUP tour, a real workout with an unbeatable view of the gabled houses.
adventure.bonus: Try to paddle the whole route without falling in.

adventure.title: Free Ferry to Amsterdam-Noord + NDSM Wharf Wander
adventure.description: Hop the free ferry behind Centraal Station and lose an afternoon exploring NDSM's graffiti-covered shipyards and floating cafes.
adventure.bonus: Take a photo with the giant 'Selfie' street art near the wharf.

adventure.title: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Over the Dutch Countryside
adventure.description: Drift silently over tulip fields, windmills, and canals as the sun comes up, the Netherlands from a totally different altitude.
adventure.bonus: Toast with the traditional post-flight glass of bubbly.

culture.title: A Film at the Eye
culture.description: Take the free ferry across the IJ to a white origami building on the water and watch something you would never normally pick.
culture.bonus: Choose the film with the least appealing poster.

culture.title: The Gallery of Honour at the Rijksmuseum
culture.description: Walk the long hall of Dutch Golden Age masters straight down to the Night Watch at the end of it.
culture.bonus: Stand at the far end and walk the whole hall without stopping first.

culture.title: Inside a Canal House at Museum Van Loon
culture.description: See how one family actually lived on the Keizersgracht for three hundred years, garden and coach house included.
culture.bonus: Go out to the formal garden behind the house.

culture.title: Opera at the Dutch National Opera & Ballet
culture.description: Dress up for a full production on the Amstel, in the house that stages the most ambitious work in the country.
culture.bonus: Read the synopsis beforehand and then ignore it.

culture.title: Photography at Foam
culture.description: Three floors of contemporary photography in a canal house, small enough to see properly in an hour.
culture.bonus: Buy a print or a book on the way out.

culture.title: Van Gogh, Room by Room
culture.description: Two hours with the largest collection of his work anywhere, hung so that you watch the colour arrive.
culture.bonus: Find the last painting he finished and sit with it.

culture.title: A Concert at the Concertgebouw
culture.description: Hear an orchestra in a hall whose acoustics are counted among the three best on earth.
culture.bonus: Try the free Wednesday lunch concert first, then book the real thing.

culture.title: The Annexe at the Anne Frank House
culture.description: Climb behind the bookcase and walk the rooms where eight people hid for two years, in near silence.
culture.bonus: Book weeks ahead. Tickets are timed and sell out.

foodie.title: Dinner at Breda on the Singel
foodie.description: A long, quiet, surprising set menu in a canal-side room where the kitchen changes the dishes constantly and never over-explains.
foodie.bonus: Go in with no idea what you are eating.

foodie.title: Fries and Sauce at Vleminckx
foodie.description: Join the permanent queue in an alley off the Kalverstraat for a paper cone of double-fried potatoes under too much sauce.
foodie.bonus: Order oorlog, war, and find out why.

foodie.title: Genever at Wynand Fockink
foodie.description: Stand in a 1679 tasting room with no seats and bend over the counter to take the first sip from a glass filled to the brim.
foodie.bonus: Do the bow, hands behind your back, mouth to the glass.

foodie.title: Rijsttafel at Restaurant Blauw
foodie.description: Sit down to fifteen small Indonesian dishes at once, the colonial-era feast the Dutch turned into an institution of their own.
foodie.bonus: Eat every dish before you go back for seconds of your favourite.

foodie.title: Brunch at Bakers & Roasters
foodie.description: Kiwi-Brazilian breakfasts in De Pijp: banana bread, chorizo hash, and coffee that takes itself seriously.
foodie.bonus: Put your name down and wait it out rather than leaving.

foodie.title: Beers Under the Windmill at Brouwerij 't IJ
foodie.description: Drink strong Dutch beer at picnic tables in the shadow of a working 1814 windmill on the east side of town.
foodie.bonus: Try the Zatte, then something you cannot pronounce.

foodie.title: The Tasting Menu at Restaurant Rijks
foodie.description: Eat a Michelin-starred menu built on the Rijksmuseum's own collection, in a glass room beside the museum garden.

foodie.title: Apple Pie at Winkel 43
foodie.description: Queue on the Noordermarkt corner for a wedge of appeltaart the size of a doorstop, under a mountain of unsweetened cream.
foodie.bonus: Go on Saturday, when the farmers' market is running around you.

foodie.title: Bitterballen and a Beer at Café Hoppe
foodie.description: Post up at one of the Jordaan's oldest brown cafes for a plate of bitterballen and a properly poured Dutch beer.
foodie.bonus: Order it 'op straat' (on the street) like a local.

foodie.title: Stroopwafel Straight Off the Griddle at Albert Cuyp Market
foodie.description: Watch a vendor press and fill a stroopwafel to order at Amsterdam's biggest street market, then eat it warm on the spot.
foodie.bonus: Try one flavor you've never seen before.

foodie.title: Dinner at De Kas, a Restaurant Inside a Greenhouse
foodie.description: Eat a chef's-menu dinner grown in the restaurant's own greenhouse gardens, one of Amsterdam's most memorable meals.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server what was picked from the garden that morning.

8ball.title: Free Ferry, No Plan
8ball.description: Take the free ferry to Amsterdam-Noord with zero itinerary and just see where your feet take you.
8ball.bonus: Don't check your phone for directions, ask a stranger instead.

8ball.title: Eat Raw Herring Street-Cart Style
8ball.description: Tip your head back and eat a whole Hollandse Nieuwe herring the traditional way, by the tail, from a street cart.
8ball.bonus: Do it in one bite, no cutting.
